Yard chart

This page loads its own JavaScript from a file beside it, rather than inline. That is the ordinary shape of an exported artefact, and it is the case R1.5's policy has to cover: the review layer's own assets must still load while the document's do not.

The paragraph you are reading is in the file and is editable. The chart body below is written by the sibling script, so its text is not in the file at all.

Median handover, current period
Waiting for the sibling script.

Note that the sibling script is referenced by src, with no inline DOM-write pattern in the document itself. The static detection rule scans inline script bodies, so it does not see this one — a known false negative, recorded beside I5 rather than fixed by guessing harder.

Every figure this page would display is invented.
